title: smol brains
pitch: raise tiny creatures with real neural-network brains. teach them words. they will learn the wrong ones.
controls: tools: grab, tickle (reward), tap (scold), talk (1-4). drag to carry or throw, drag empty ground to pan, pinch or wheel to zoom. space pauses, [ ] speed, t talk, b brain viewer.
how_to: teach nouns first: pick 💬 talk and tap the food or the ball a few times. then say verbs while a smol does them (eat while it eats).
tickle right after the good thing. ten seconds later rewards whatever it is doing then, which is how smols learn weird superstitions.
smols copy each other. throw grumps back to the hollow with ✋ grab, and tickle a smol that runs from one.
the brain viewer (b) is the cheat code: if the eat neuron lights up for shrooms, you know what to scold.
got a code from a friend? paste it in the lab and their smol arrives through the warp gate, brain and words included.
